full_judgment: 13. On examination of the impugned Memo (Annexure 1 to the writ petition No.3772 of 2008) it transpires that the Government has given an administrative approval for construction of No.5 Budh Bari Bazar Union Parishad Complex Bhaban of Golapgonj under District-Sylhet over 0.52 acres of land at Mouza Kalijouri of Khatian Nos.672,. 538, 1657 and 680 and Plot Nos.728, 729, 730, 727, 724 and 726. From the report of the Additional Deputy Commissioner relating to selection of the land of UPCB (Annexure-1 to the affidavit-in-opposition filed by respondent No. 3) it further transpires that on examination of the report of UNO and relevant documents, it was found that attempts had been taken for a long period for selection for the land of UPCB but no one earlier proposed/agreed to donate any land for this purpose and accordingly, as per decision of the Parishad advertisements were published in newspaper for donation of some land for this purpose, that in response to the advertisement Haji Md Abdul Momith (Petitioner in WP 3772 of 2008) gifted 0.52 acres of land at Chandpur Mouza by executing a registered or deed of gift in favour of the Government/Union Parishad on 12-2-2008 and that subsequently, on 24-2-2008 one Hafiz Mojir Uddin and two others gifted 0.40 acres of land in favour of the Parishad.
